scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && find apps libs -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.d.ts' -o -name '*.js.map' \) ! -name 'jest.config.js' -delete
scripts.build:all: APP=api pnpm build:app && APP=auth-handler pnpm build:app && APP=authorizer pnpm build:app && APP=migrate pnpm build:app
scripts.db:up: docker run -d --name forge-postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=forge_agents -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 5433:5432 postgres:16-alpine || docker start forge-postgres
scripts.test:newman: newman run forge-core.postman_collection.json -e forge-core.local.postman_environment.json --folder Health --folder "Platform Token Flow" --folder "Agent CRUD + Status Smoke" --folder "Chat (Spec-05)" --folder "Public Chat (Spec-08)" --folder "Metrics (Spec-09)" --bail --timeout-request 30000 --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export results/newman.xml
scripts.test:newman:dev: newman run forge-core.postman_collection.json -e forge-core.dev.postman_environment.json --folder Health --folder "Platform Token Flow" --folder "Agent CRUD + Status Smoke" --folder "Chat (Spec-05)" --folder "Public Chat (Spec-08)" --folder "Metrics (Spec-09)" --bail --timeout-request 30000 --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export results/newman.xml
scripts.test:newman:mindrithm-dev: newman run forge-core.postman_collection.json -e forge-core.mindrithm-dev.postman_environment.json --folder Health --folder "Platform Token Flow" --folder "Agent CRUD + Status Smoke" --folder "Chat (Spec-05)" --folder "Public Chat (Spec-08)" --folder "Metrics (Spec-09)" --bail --timeout-request 30000 --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export results/newman.xml
scripts.test:newman:live: newman run forge-core.postman_collection.json -e forge-core.local.postman_environment.json --folder Health --folder "Platform Token Flow" --folder "Agent CRUD + Status Smoke" --folder "Chat (Spec-05)" --folder "Public Chat (Spec-08)" --folder "Metrics (Spec-09)" --env-var skipLiveTests=false --bail --timeout-request 30000 --reporters cli,junit --reporter-junit-export results/newman.xml
